svg.aria-label: Eight tool servers, one door, one token: 1. Operator: The ToolHive operator and its CRDs install from their own Kustomization first, so every MCPServer resource has a kind to reconcile. 2. Servers: Eight MCPServer objects run one tool server each in the mcp-tools group. Those that need credentials read them from 1Password-backed Secrets. 3. Gateway: A virtual MCP server aggregates the group's tools behind one Service, prefixes each tool with its server name, and applies per-server tool filters. 4. Token: Envoy checks a bearer token on the MCP route. The token is generated once and pushed to 1Password for the consumers that call it. 5. Search: A small CPU embedding server indexes tools for each session, so the gateway can pick the right ones without sharing the B70.
